description: Defines a macro for generating SQL page functions, including enum definitions, string parsing, display formatting, and evaluation logic for functions within a web server context.

classes.name: SqlPageFunctionName
classes.description: Enumeration of all SQL page functions with string parsing and display implementations, and an async evaluate method.

methods.name: from_str
methods.description: Parses a string to a corresponding SqlPageFunctionName enum variant.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Formats the enum variant as a string, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates the function based on request context, database connection, and parameters.
